create_data2vec_text_model: create a Data2VecTextModel transformer for bidirectional text encoding with configurable layers and attention heads
build_causal_lm_with_data2vec: build a Data2VecTextForCausalLM model for autoregressive next-token prediction with language modeling head
run_masked_lm_with_data2vec: run a Data2VecTextForMaskedLM model for masked token prediction with cross-entropy loss on masked positions
test_sequence_classification: test a Data2VecTextForSequenceClassification model for sentence-level classification with configurable number of labels
review_token_classification: review a Data2VecTextForTokenClassification model for per-token labeling tasks such as NER with dropout and linear classifier
summarize_question_answering: summarize a Data2VecTextForQuestionAnswering model for extractive QA that predicts start and end token positions
